## Shift Notes and Audit Summary

- The opening float was verified at $350.00 prior to evening service by the lead bartender.
- Mid-shift petty cash reimbursement of $35.00 was disbursed for emergency citrus fruit purchases, receipt attached.
- Credit card batch terminal closed successfully with authorization batch #8824 for $1,985.25.
- Drawer count indicates an overage of $65.00 relative to the expected cash total.
- Because the drawer is over, deduct $65.00 from the next morning float to balance the safe ledger.
- Prepared standard bank deposit envelope with $765.25 and placed in safe bag #408.
- Retained baseline cash float of $300.00 locked in the under-counter drawer for the morning shift.
- Final sign-off completed by lead bartender and manager on duty.
